subject: world_language
concept: Producing the core creative or analytical component of the capstone project in the target language
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student drafts the core component of their project using a genre-appropriate organizer in the target language
exercise.abstract: Student produces the core written or spoken component of their capstone project at a near-native level in the target language

assessment.mastery_threshold: core component demonstrates near-native command appropriate to the project's chosen genre
misconception_flags: produces a component that is technically correct but doesn't genuinely fulfill the project's stated purpose

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
